title: Salvation, grace, works, and 'am I saved'
method: coverage_search.py --regex --whole-words per sub-question (JSON runs S1-S8 in this folder); record front matter read by hand (fm-*.txt); 30 quote records re-verified against cic/texts (verify-fast-out.txt). Layers: RENDERED (a record in records/<code>/ answers; -quote/-witness/-limit says which kind), LOADED (vendored text mapped to the world via cic/corpus-map, no record), IDENTIFIED (named in the world's source registry or the cross-world queues, not vendored), OTHER (public-domain or open source outside the repo), NONE (nothing, honest_limit needed). 'confidence' is the mapper's confidence in the layer call, not formation_confidence.

layer_legend.RENDERED-limit: an honest_limit already says the world cannot answer it
layer_legend.LOADED: answer sits in vendored text mapped to the world

sub_questions.title: Faith and works, grace, and 'what must I do to be saved'
sub_questions.note: 'Faith alone, not works' is a 16th-century framing; every pre-Reformation world answers beside it, not inside it.

sub_questions.title: Original sin, inherited guilt, and infants
Assurance, losing salvation, falling away and coming back
sub_questions.note: 'Assurance' as a felt certainty is a Reformation question; the patristic worlds answer with the lapsed and perseverance.

sub_questions.title: Baptism as the new birth, is it needed, and the once-only repentance
sub_questions.note: In every pre-Reformation world 'born again' names baptism; the canon cell F4-T is answered here.

sub_questions.title: Those who never heard, and 'good without God'
Indulgences, almsgiving, paying for sin
sub_questions.note: Indulgences exist only in witt and rzg; the patristic question is redemptive almsgiving.

findings: Canon cell F1-T is not in fact forced per world in records/: only gallic, ijc and witt carry an F1-T demonstration (ijc's is bread-and-cup), and only don and hal carry F4-T. Eight of twelve worlds have no demonstration for either cell; the faith-alone question is answered by an honest_limit in don, ijc and desert, by witnesses in cappadocian, syr and hal, and by nothing in alx, pahc and rzg.

rzg has no record on justification by faith, the Reformed world's own centre, while Institutes III.11, the Second Helvetic XV-XVI and Heidelberg 60-64 are vendored; it also has no 'born again' record though regeneration is a distinct Reformed doctrine. Its predestination/assurance cluster, by contrast, is the best-built in the fleet (gravity, term, quote, demo, honest_limit).

Five vendored texts answer C4 questions head-on and are unrendered: Gregory Nazianzen Or. 40.23 and Gregory of Nyssa On Infants' Early Deaths (babies who die, cappadocian); Ambrose Concerning Repentance against the Novatians (ijc, C4-06); Augustine On Rebuke and Grace 40 'No one is certain of his own salvation' (lpc, C4-19); Augsburg Confession XII (witt, C4-06/07); Jerome Letter 42 to Marcella on the sin against the Holy Ghost (hal, C4-25).

Duplicates: pahc.quote.justin-reasonable-livers and pahc.quote.those-who-lived-reasonably-are-christians carry the same Justin sentence; gallic.quote.grievous-blasphemy-not-all-men-to-be-saved and gallic.quote.without-grievous-blasphemy-all-men-to-be-saved carry the same Conf. XIII.7 sentence.

Record/map drift: witt.term.free-will says the library does not carry a developed predestination doctrine, but Formula of Concord XI (Jacobs 1911) is vendored and mapped to witt; witt.source.book-of-concord is registered kind: unvendored. rzg.source.ecclesiastical-ordinances-1541 is registered unvendored while calvin-geneva-council_ordonnances-ecclesiastiques-fra_tournes1735.txt is mapped (a 1735 printing; check it is the 1541 text).

pelagius_epistula-ad-demetriadem-lat_migne.txt is vendored but mapped only to the unbuilt 'pelagianism' world; hal, lpc and gallic construct the controversy entirely from the opponents' side (lpc.contested.grace-pelagius-characterization names this).

lpc.quote.pardon-through-a-wicked-clergyman is Augustine's sermon on the unforgivable sin (Sermon 71) but is indexed only for the wicked-minister question; the C4-25 answer is already verified and rendered, just unreachable by retrieve_when.
